description: Real RSS feeds fetched with the AfricaSignalBot user agent, one request per host, pausing for each host's robots.txt crawl-delay.
trimmed: The repository is public and article text is the outlets' copyright, so body text is truncated: every <description> and <content:encoded> is cut to 300 characters (the plan's quotation limit for news). Everything else (channel header, item fields, namespaces, dates, links, categories, GUIDs) is as served. original_sha256 is of the untrimmed response.
